Planning your enquiry

Useful details for a
local project.

  1. Identify the location. Share the site name, access point and the organisation responsible.
  2. Describe the work. Explain what needs inspecting, recovering, servicing or assessing.
  3. Share the conditions. Include known depth, access limits, equipment information and relevant images.
  4. Discuss the timing. Mobilisation and the final scope depend on assessment and availability.

Questions from nearby customers

A clear starting point.

Where is Cyclonite Tech based?+

Cyclonite Tech is based at Manjung Point 3 in Seri Manjung, Perak, Malaysia. The full office address and enquiry details are on our Contact page.

What underwater services are available?+

Our services include diving and underwater inspection, air diving to 50 metres, diver-assisted tank cleaning, salvage and recovery, and specialist underwater works.

Can I discuss a project in Lumut, Sitiawan or elsewhere in Perak?+

Yes. Send your site location and requirements to the Seri Manjung team. We assess the scope, access, conditions and availability before agreeing the work.

What information helps you assess an enquiry?+

Share the service required, site location, a brief scope, preferred timing and relevant drawings or photographs. For equipment work, include the make, model and fault description.
